call_sites.purpose: Produce a detailed written specification for a software program based on the user's request, enumerating features, classes, functions, and methods before any code is generated.
call_sites.output_contract: Free-form text. Must include: (1) explicit description of what the program does and its features; (2) named list of core classes, functions, and methods with brief comments; (3) statement that main.py is the entry point. No code should be generated at this stage.
